Keywords: Trial by Combat (Order of the Crown Trial by Combat)

Variants.Content: Entry Trial by combat turned legal disputes over to a public contest of arms, courage, and divine providence. The prosecution and the defendant each designate a champion, and the winner's life and death are regarded as the judgment of the Seven Gods; those who are unable to hold the sword themselves can find knights, mercenaries, or relatives and friends to fight on their behalf. Nobles look at it Institutions recognize divine providence but cannot eliminate manipulation, fear, and inequality.
